ruleDefinitions.name: Reconnaissance Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects activity as "net user administrator /domain" and "net group domain admins /domain" Note: Unmapped fields: AccessMask, ObjectType, ObjectName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4661 AND AccessMask = "0x2d" AND (ObjectType = "SAM\_USER" OR ObjectType = "SAM\_GROUP") AND ObjectName = RGX("^S\\-1\\-5\\-21\\-") AND (ObjectName = RGX("\\-500$") OR ObjectName = RGX("\\-512$")))
